'''Myocaine''' was a type of muscle relaxant used during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was odorless, colorless and tasteless.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
